id./param/scenario/cs/c_110_cs_020.pack|cs_: "Papa... I'm home.
"Who's there?

"You... my son Norberto!!
  How dare you show your face here!!
"E-eeek! I'm sorry!!

"Hey, Norberto.
  You got the wrong idea, didn't you?

"With your chivalry, did you make
  the whole world smile?
"...No, not yet.
"Then why did you come back!!

"You left with big talk, yet you come back
  without fulfilling your dream!
  I didn't raise you to be like that!
"P-Papa...

"...Damn it. If I weren't in this body,
  I'd punch you.

"Thank you, Papa!
  You always did believe in me!

"I did come back with my dream half done,
  but there's a reason for that.

"...Erdwin's Lantern that fell, is it?
  I do sense a bottomless evil.

"Yes. With that black sun in the sky,
  people can't laugh from the heart.

"...So I'll do something about it.
  I'll bring back a bright world
  and make my dream come true this time!

"And, Papa, I have a favor.
  To face that evil black sun,
  could you lend me your strength?

"...Master, I ask you too. The world is filled
  with an ominous aura now. I seek your
  teaching to dispel this darkness.

"Ha ha ha! That's a hoot!
  You show up after ten-odd years
  and ask me to lend you strength!?

"...Fine! I'll help you all the way
  until that big lump is smashed!
"Papa, really!?

"Yeah! Even a wastrel son like you,
  chivalry means helping those in trouble!
  A knight never goes back on his word!

"...Right, let's start with the great trial
  passed down in our family since ancient times!
"A great trial...?

"Yes. In the Heliodor Shrine on the coast,
  a golden-gleaming giant is sealed.
  Defeat it.

"But just winning won't do. You two must
  join forces and finish it with
  Giant Slash. That's the trial.

"Pass it and you'll gain the strongest
  weapon, one that faces any great power.
  Even that big lump won't be a match.

"...If I can get the strongest weapon,
  I'm fired up! I accept your trial!

"Ha! Still all talk, I see!
  I'll break the seal on the Heliodor Shrine.
  Do your best, you two!
